tagline: Sports research, picks and capper communities
brief: A 2027 refresh of the old bolt logo. Keep the lime and near-black palette. One flat mark that is an S, a lightning bolt and a dollar sign at once, and that works as an app icon and at 16 px.
criteria: Success: reads as S, bolt and $ in one glance; holds at 16 px; works in one colour; sits comfortably next to modern sports and data apps.

concepts.name: Bolt dollar
concepts.idea: An angular S struck by a bolt that shows only above and below, like a dollar sign.
rationale: The S diagonal and the two bolt ends zigzag, so the whole mark reads as lightning
Every edge sits at 0, 45 or 90 degrees with one stem weight
The wordmark is drawn from the same stems and 45 degree corners

recommendation: Bolt dollar is the final direction: lime on near-black as the primary, near-black on lime for the app icon.
next_steps: Swap the site header, favicon and social avatars
Apply to VOLT and the advert end card
